prompt: Explain what DeltaNet decode latency means in one short paragraph.

fla.generated_text: DeltaNet decode latency refers to the time required for the system to process and reconstruct a specific segment of a video stream after receiving the corresponding delta-encoded data packets. Unlike traditional methods that decode entire frames independently, DeltaNet utilizes a predictive model to generate only the differences (deltas) between consecutive frames, significantly reducing the data volume transmitted. Consequently, the decode latency represents the delay incurred while the receiver's model processes these compressed differences to render the next frame, which is generally lower than standard decoding times due to the reduced computational load and network bandwidth usage, though it depends on the accuracy of the prediction model and the speed of the inference engine.
